name: limit-bytes-over-limit
description: A definition of 65,537 bytes, one byte past the maximum definition size, is refused before any further validation runs.
notes: Otherwise identical in shape to limit-bytes-at-limit: the same 1,024 distinct, pairwise-distinct test/-prefixed refs in a slot's set binding, each still 60-61 code points (far under the 1,024-code-point cap) and the set still at the 1,024-member cap, not over it. Every other published limit is respected the same way as limit-bytes-at-limit; one extra padding byte on a single ref is the only difference, so the extra byte alone is genuinely what triggers the refusal.
